item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-11-19
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天论坛的主要动静集中在 Spark Program 的提案审阅和新提案发布上 [S07, S14, S15, S16, S02, S06]。委员会对 ckb-adversary、CKB Escrow Security Test Kit、ShareCut、ServiceSeal 给出 Pending/邀请修改反馈，ckb-adversary 作者也回应了攻击范围问题 [S07, S08, S14, S15, S16]。开发者侧，ckbup 更新到可列出、切换和删除版本 [S01]；Fiber Claim Cell 澄清通道流动性不由 grant 出资 [S11, S12, S13]；MeterNet 申请人表示自担硬件费用继续试点 [S09, S10]。 ## 重点话题 Spark Program 审阅反馈集中：ckb-adversary、CKB Escrow Security Test Kit、ShareCut、ServiceSeal 都被标为 Pending/邀请修改，而不是直接拒绝 [S07, S14, S15, S16]；ckb-adversary 作者回应称，攻击改变的是每笔交易都有的字段（如 outputs、since、witnesses 等），不是脚本逻辑，因此同一套攻击可跑在任何 lock 或 type 上 [S08]。 新提案方面，CKB ClearSign 提出 TypeScript 库和 CCC signer 包装器，在签名前独立验证交易输入并用白话解释交易 [S02]；Will On-Chain 申请 1000 美元、为期 4...

item.title: Spark Program | CKB ClearSign: verify before you sign (1 posts)
item.description: 1. Project CKB ClearSign: a TypeScript library + CCC signer wrapper that independently verifies a transaction’s inputs and explains it in plain language before the user signs. Repo: github.com/RaceeyXo/ckb-clearsign (MIT) 2. Applicant RaceeyXo: software engineer (full-stack Web3, AI engineering). GitHub: RaceeyXo. 3. Problem A CKB transaction only references its inputs by out point (txHash:index). The capacity, lock, type and data of those cells come from an indexer/RPC, and CCC trusts that answer. A lying, compromised or MITM’d RPC can make a wallet show “fee 0.0001 CKB” while the user actually signs something very different. As discussed in the October DevRel AMA, CCC deliberately...

item.title: [DIS] KeyMe — CKB's PSBT: Open Air-Gapped Signing and the First DIY Hardware (1 posts)
item.description: If you have used a Bitcoin hardware wallet, the flow is familiar. A watch-only app builds a transaction. It hands it to a small device as a QR code or a file. The device shows the amount and the destination. You approve. The signed transaction goes back to the app, which broadcasts it. The machine that holds the key never talks to the internet. Bitcoin calls that container a PSBT (Partially Signed Bitcoin Transaction). The devices have names you may know: Coldcard, SeedSigner, Specter DIY. They do not share one design. They share one rule: the key lives on a device that cannot reach the network, and the device shows you what you are signing. CKB has the same need and no open equivalent....

item.title: Community Fund DAO voting in numbers (1 posts)
item.description: Really interesting topic and definitely an important one for Nervos. Personally, I think the problem isn’t necessarily that people don’t care about voting. A lot of CKB holders probably don’t even know these votes are happening, or how to participate. Maybe we should focus more on making voting easier and giving proposals more visibility. Even a simple notification when a new vote is open could make a difference. Thanks for bringing this up, I think it’s something the community really needs to discuss more.

item.title: [DIS] Fiber Claim Cell: Async Receive and On-Chain Claims for Fiber LSPs (3 posts)
item.description: Following up on my earlier reply in the Fiber LSP discussion, I’m excited to share Fiber Claim Cell! Since then, I’ve narrowed the project from a full LSP service to an on-chain claim module for existing LSPs and wallets. The focus is receiving a Fiber payment without a usable channel, with the recipient coming online later to claim it on CKB within a defined claim window. I’d love feedback from the Fiber team and LSP operators on how this could complement the hosted LSP work already under way. item.description: CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint 项目结项报告 1. 结项评价 / Final Evaluation 结项日期 / Completion Date：2026年11月5日 1.1 评价摘要 / Evaluation Summary CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint 是一项面向 CKB-VM 维护者的验证工具项目：以 Sail RISC-V 模型为独立参考，对固定版本解释器的指令执行逐步“对答案”，保存首个差异及可重放记录，并探索生产 Rust 代码与规范之间的机器检查证明。项目完成了严格差分工具、ADD 的条件性 Lean 4 证明、Rocq/Coq 兼容性探索，以及附带固定工具和证据的公开发布。 1.2 主要成果 / Key Achievements 交付可逐步定位差异的运行时工具。 最终公开结果覆盖 ADD 13例、ADDI 10例、BEQ 10例，共33个案例、398个提交步，双方结果全部一致；每例可单独重放。对记录轨迹注入6类差异共194次，均被识别并定位。该数字反映比较器对指定变异的检测结果，不是发现了194个 CKB-VM 漏洞。 完成与生产执行路径关联的条件性 ADD 证明。 Lean 4 定理连接生产 Rust 入口与 Sail 生成定义，覆盖 ADD 寄存器效果、x0 写入抑制和 PC 更新；另有从同一32位原始指令编码出发的解码对应定理。两者经过 kernel 检查，不依赖 sorryAx，但仍依赖明确的外部声明、工具链和状态前提。...

item.description: Hi @xingtianchunyan, Thank you for the clear and detailed feedback, and for taking the time to review ckb-msig. Both points make sense to us.
